units.source_text: 我本是个很自卑的人，然而这时候，我竟能将毫无泪痕的明朗的脸问着施主们而毫无愧色。

en.t: I was by nature a very self-abasing person, yet at that moment I could turn my bright, tearless face toward the patrons without the slightest shame.

units.source_text: 寺庙坐落在海滨的山崖上。

en.t: The temple stood on a seaside cliff.

units.source_text: 翻卷在日本海海面上的夏云，阻挡在凭吊的客人的背后。

en.t: Summer clouds billowing over the surface of the Sea of Japan loomed behind the visitors who had come to mourn.
